The '''Priests of Nether''' were an [[Oblee]] religious group that resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Oblis]] thousands of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The priests did not engage in acts of worship, but instead, they spent their lives meditating and contemplating the world around them. At some point, a [[Unidentified wandering trader|wandering traveler]] brought a dangerous [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]], known as the [[Darkstaff]], to Oblis, which began manipulating the Oblee into using the artifact to repel a [[shadow creature]] from their homeworld. The Priests of Nether suspected that the staff was manipulating the Oblee to achieve its own ends, but despite the priests' concerns, the Oblee [[scientist-philosopher]]s used the Darkstaff to power a machine that would send the shadow creature away. The activation of the machine triggered a [[Destruction of Oblis|cataclysm]] that destroyed Oblis and the Oblee, including the priests, who were transformed into incorporeal beings known as "shadow lurkers."
